description:
HSE Information Center is where safety professionals go for material that holds up in the field.
This channel covers major incident case studies, process safety walkthroughs, certification guidance, and practical training content for people working in oil and gas, construction, petrochemicals and manufacturing.
You will find full investigation breakdowns of incidents, step by step HAZOP walkthroughs applied to real P&IDs, explanations of normalisation of deviance and guidance on NEBOSH, IOSH, CMIOSH and CSP certification routes.
Everything is presented by a CMIOSH-certified Corporate HSE Manager with two master's degrees, 24 years of international experience, and working knowledge of the GCC regulatory environment.
New videos regularly. Free templates, toolbox talks and calculators at: https://hseinformation.com/
Subscribe if you want safety content written by someone who has done the job.
